messages.author: b5b25388deea7620
messages.subject: Circular geoms for bubble plots
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to build a bubble plot from the following data (below)
where "size" would be the relative size of a circle plotted at x,y
coordinates. I've looked at this group's email archive and
stackoverflow but can't find anyone that has done this specifically
with ggplot.

I used ggplot with geom_point with shape = 1, but am only getting
small circles even for very large values. I wanted to know if anyone
has built or specified circular geoms that can be plotted by
specifying x,y coordinates (similar to geom_rect), or of there is an
easier way to make much larger circles than what geom_point is
generating. I've tried scaling the values of size but I still get the
same relative size circles with geom_point, but a different legend
because of the scale. I have other variables to specify color, but
ideally these would be semi-transparent especially when two circles
are close or overlapping.

Attached is a jpg of output of:
ggplot(sampledata, aes(x, y, size = size)) + geom_point(shape = 1)

Thanks,
Marck Vaisman

messages.subject: Re: Circular geoms for bubble plots
parts:
?scale_size_continuous , e.g.

ggplot(sampledata, aes(x, y, size = size)) + geom_point(shape = 1) +
scale_size_continuous(to=c(1,30))
